description: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration system for automating software deployment, scaling, and management.

audience_guidance.student: Kubernetes manages containers. If its control panel is exposed, attackers can take over all the apps running inside.
audience_guidance.developer: Do not hardcode secrets; use Kubernetes Secrets or Vault. Apply least privilege RBAC to ServiceAccounts.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Look for exposed kube-apiserver on port 6443 or Kubelet on 10250. Test anonymous access.
audience_guidance.pentester: Attempt unauthenticated Kubelet exec (port 10250). If you compromise a pod, check the mounted ServiceAccount token.
audience_guidance.security_team: Ensure the API server is not exposed to the internet. Implement strict NetworkPolicies. Audit RBAC regularly.
